title: Immunogenicity and Safety of a Monovalent Glycoprotein-Conjugated (Diptheria Toxin -CRM197) Hib Vaccine in 13-59 Months Old Healthy Children
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and immunogenicity of single dose of two commercially available vaccines used to prevent Haemophilus influenzae type b infections in children 13-59 months of age.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants 13-59 months of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior Hib vaccine administration.
* History of serious reaction(s) following vaccination.
* Any vaccination within 7 days of study vaccination.
* Known or suspected immune impairment.
* Premature (before 37th week of gestation) or birth weight less than 2500g
* For additional entry criteria please refer to the protocol.
